title: DLSS5 Updater catalog
description: catalog.json, schema version 1. Sections are independent: a reader uses the sections it knows and ignores the rest, so new sections and new properties are not breaking changes. Removing or changing the meaning of a property bumps `schema`.

schema.description: Schema version. Readers refuse a higher number.

repository.description: owner/repo that hosts the mirror assets.

generated.description: When any section last changed (UTC). Absent until the first run.

sections.description: One entry per catalog area. `renodx`, `renodxDlss`, `neural`, `optiscalerCompat`, `addons`, `frameLimiters`, `luma` and `shaderPacks` exist so far; later areas (feeder) are added as new keys.

historyEntry.description: An earlier build of the same file.

file.description: A downloadable binary. A reader installs only entries that have `sha256`; it downloads from `mirrorUrl` when present, else from `url`, and refuses the file when its SHA-256 or size differ.

name.description: File name as the author publishes it, e.g. renodx-hades2.addon64.

arch.description: Bitness of the file; "both" for an add-on or shader package that serves 32-bit and 64-bit games.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the current build.

version.description: Upstream snapshots carry no version, so a build is named by the UTC date we first saw it plus the first seven hash characters: 2026-10-21-ab12cd3.

verified.description: Date of the last full download that confirmed the hash (re-done weekly).

etag.description: Provenance for conditional requests. Readers ignore it.

lastModified.description: Provenance for conditional requests. Readers ignore it.

license.description: SPDX id of the source repository's licence, when GitHub reports one.

mirrorUrl.description: Immutable copy in this repository's release assets (named by hash, never overwritten). Only for MIT, BSD-2/3, Apache-2.0, ISC and Unlicense sources. Absent = pinned: upstream url plus hash only.

mod.description: The upstream games-index mod this file belongs to.

payload.description: Add-on packages: what the app installs from the zip (or the plain binary).

unplaced.description: Add-on packages: zip entries the app does not place; the package is then `manual`.

mod.description: A game (or related mod) with its RenoDX add-on.

id.description: Stable id: the games-index game id, or a slug of the wiki name.

aliases.description: Other titles that match this entry (store titles, overrides).

listing.description: `deprecated` and `related` entries are shown for information; they are not offered for install.

status.description: Upstream's own rating from games-index: stable, beta, experimental.

compat.description: The wiki table's mark, else the games-index rating. Absent when upstream hasn't said.

generic.description: The game has no file of its own: upstream points it at the generic engine mod (see section.generic).

blocked.description: Set by overrides.json; a blocked entry has no files and is never offered.

engineGame.description: A row of the wiki's per-engine tables: a game reported to work with the generic mod of that engine.

notes.description: As written on the wiki (for Unreal Extended: Native HDR, Engine.ini, Upgrade Path: On, resource upgrades).

method.description: Unreal Extended only, read from `notes`: `upgrade` (Upgrade Path: On), `native` (Upgrade Path: Off or Native HDR) or `ini` (Engine.ini). Absent when the notes don't say.

upgrades.description: Unreal Extended only: the resource upgrades the notes list. Absent when none.

copyDestinations.description: Unreal Extended only: `Upgrade Copy Destinations` On (true) or Off (false), when the notes say.

engineIni.description: Unreal Extended only: Engine.ini settings named in the notes (`r.` keys only).

overrides.description: A copy of the renodx block of overrides.json (see README). Readers apply it before any fuzzy matching.

dlssBuild.description: One renodx-dlss release. `file` is a zip whose only entry is `renodx-dlss.addon64`; it is pinned by hash and never mirrored.

version.description: The part of the tag after renodx-dlss-SF-, e.g. 26.1003.2350 or 0.55.

updated.description: When this section's content last changed.

source.description: The releases API url the builds were read from.

neuralBuild.description: A binary kept in this repository's mirror. A reader downloads `mirrorUrl`, checks `sha256` and `size`, and saves the file as `name`.

name.description: nvngx_dlssnr.dll, renodx-dlss5.addon64 (Lecram v10 and older) or dlss5-nr.addon64 (Lecram v11 and newer).

version.description: nvngx_dlssnr.dll: the file version (310.8.3). Lecram: the build label inside the add-on (v8.5.0-rc10).

fileVersion.description: The file's PE version as digits (0.2026.828.517). Tells apart builds that share one `version`; absent when the file has none.

url.description: Provenance: the download the build was taken from. Absent for a file added by hand. Readers ignore it.

current.description: The newest build. Absent until one has been mirrored.

history.description: Older builds, newest first; with `current` at most 20.

updated.description: When this section's content last changed.

source.description: The releases API url the zip builds were read from.

updated.description: When this section's content last changed.

source.description: The OptiScaler wiki page (raw Markdown) the games were read from.

hudfixSource.description: The wiki page the HUDfix-incompatible names were read from.

games.description: Upstream order within each list; lists in main, upscalerMods, lumaUe order.

page.description: Slug of the game's own page in the OptiScaler wiki; absent when upstream lists a plain name.

inputs.description: Upscaler inputs as upstream writes them: DLSS, FSR2, FSR3, FSR3.1/4, XeSS.

optiPatcher.description: Upstream marks the game as supported by OptiPatcher. Always false in the two small lists, which have no such column.

notes.description: Short plain-text note (links and line breaks flattened).

hudfixIncompatible.description: Games upstream lists as incompatible with OptiFG's HUDfix.

payloadItem.description: One file of an add-on download that the app installs.

entry.description: Path inside the zip (the file name for a plain binary).

kind.description: addon = into the game's add-on folder; effect = below the game's Shaders folder.

dest.description: Effects only: path below the game's Shaders folder, with '/' separators.

packLayout.description: Where the Shaders and Textures folders of a shader pack sit inside its zip. The app extracts everything below these prefixes.

shadersDir.description: Zip prefix ending in '/', e.g. ReShade_HDR_shaders-ab12cd3/Shaders/.

texturesDir.description: Absent when the pack has no Textures folder.

effects.description: File names of the effects (.fx) in the Shaders folder, without folders, sorted. Presets name their effects by file name.

addon.description: An add-on package from crosire's Addons.ini.

effectInstallPath.description: As the list writes it, relative to the game folder.

license.description: SPDX id of the repository the files are published from, when GitHub reports one.

managedBy.description: The app manages this add-on as a component of its own (renodx, display-commander, relimiter, dfc, lecram-dlss5, gitc-uplift, dlss5-feeder); no files are listed.

manual.description: Why the app cannot install the package itself; the repository link is the way in.

limiter.description: A frame-limiter add-on (ReLimiter, Display Commander): the add-on binaries of one release. A 32-bit file is absent when the release has none.

repository.description: owner/repo the files are published from.

release.description: The release tag the files were read from. Display Commander republishes the tag `latest`.

license.description: SPDX id of the repository's licence. Absent = no licence found, so the files are pinned (author's URL plus hash), never mirrored.

lumaSection.description: Luma Framework (Filoppi/Luma-Framework): the wiki's completed mods and generic Unreal Engine games, merged with the zips of the latest release. Licence NOASSERTION: every zip is pinned (upstream URL plus hash), never mirrored.

release.description: The release tag the zips were read from (`latest-755`). Part of every file URL.

id.description: Release asset `Luma-<id>.zip` without the bitness suffix: `Prey`, `BioShock_Series`, `Unity_Engine`, `Unreal_Engine`.

status.description: Absent for a zip the wiki does not list.

package.description: `id` of a package; absent when the mod is published elsewhere (Nexus Mods).

unrealPackage.description: `id` of the package that is the generic Unreal Engine mod.

shaderPack.description: A shader repository pinned to a release tag or a commit; the zip is hashed like every other file.

default.description: Pre-selected for new setups (the HDR essentials).

version.description: Release tag, or the first seven characters of the commit.

license.description: SPDX id: GitHub's, or the one checked by hand when GitHub reports none.

updated.description: When this section's content last changed.
